# T77 proposed contract: complete-source column/pylon dimension literals

DESIGN ONLY. T76 actual capacity acceptance is a prerequisite for production implementation. Existing T75 frozen files remain unchanged. Independent evidence and review precede code/tests. No new external dependency.

## One operation and one input

TS `extractColumnPylonDimensionLiterals(value: unknown)` / Python `extract_column_pylon_dimension_literals(value: object)` accepts exactly one COMPLETE document-text-v3 artifact, without an outer DTO or optional budget/selection/metadata. It calls the explicit T76 large reader before accessing any selected page or text. Its result retains the large policy, complete source content hash, original source ID/SHA, full extractor profile and profile hash. It never changes source content or profile, approves a release, or admits an HTTP request.

The extractor returns ALL supported literals in original page/located-record order. Equal values/raw at distinct original paths remain separate. No first/minimum/sorting/deduplication/pairing. More than128 supported literals refuses the entire result with INPUT_LIMIT; no partial prefix.

## Exact literal language

Remove at most one final U000A LF and then only U0020 SPACE at both edges. Preserve full original raw unchanged. Whole remaining view must match:

`(Колонна|Пилон) ([1-9][0-9]{0,8})х([1-9][0-9]{0,8})(мм) ([+-]?(?:0|[1-9][0-9]{0,3})) этаж \[scope\]`

`х` is Cyrillic U0445. Every shown separator is exactly one ASCII SPACE. Scope has1..200 Unicode codepoints, no leading/trailing U0020 SPACE, brackets, C0/C1 controls, U2028/U2029 or UFFFD. It must contain at least one codepoint outside this exact frozen whitespace set: U0009..U000D, U001C..U0020, U0085, U00A0, U1680, U2000..U200A, U2028, U2029, U202F, U205F, U3000. Never use host trim/Unicode whitespace classes. Internal NBSP/astral characters otherwise survive unchanged. No Unicode normalization/casefold/glyph join. Complete raw over8192 codepoints is unsupported language and SKIPPED, not a whole-source resource refusal. These are finite literal-language bounds, not engineering bounds. Signed0/+0/-0 are retained as literal labels; no numeric floor/elevation interpretation. Dimensions are canonical positive decimal STRINGS, FIRST/SECOND in source order, never width/depth or sorted sides.

Accept only originally located lines on pages whose exact validated quality is TEXT_LAYER_CANDIDATE and whose original unlocatedLines is empty. Every other page stays fully validated/hashed and is listed in excludedPages with pageNumber and finite reason PAGE_NOT_CANDIDATE or UNLOCATED_RECORDS (unlocated precedence). Unsupported raw language produces no literal and carries no absence/completeness meaning. No lines joined across records/pages.

## Output

Shared envelope: schemaVersion `column-pylon-dimension-literals-v1`; status SOURCE_LITERALS, sourceFileId/inputSha256/sourceArtifactContentHash, resourcePolicyVersion (fixed large), exact extractorProfile/extractorProfileHash; literals array0..128; excludedPages in page order. Any invalid whole source returns ABSTAIN with same schema/policy and its INVALID_INPUT, INPUT_LIMIT or INVALID_TEXT_ARTIFACT reason, no partial source/literals.

Each literal keeps pageNumber/full sourcePath, full rawText, original nativeBoxPointStrings+bboxMilliPoints, complete page frame (width/height/nativeFrame), usedTextRangeCodePoints and six token objects {raw,rangeCodePoints}: kind,first,second,unit,level,scope. Ranges are half-open Unicode CODEPOINT offsets into original raw. Scope excludes brackets; used range includes brackets. No source text reconstructed from tokens. Dimension values/level/scope are represented solely by these exact raw tokens; no duplicated normalized value that could disagree.

Each literal has sourceOnly:true, calibratedProbability:null and explicit statuses rectangleStatus/grossSectionStatus/physicalMemberStatus/applicabilityStatus/renderedVisibilityStatus all UNVERIFIED. No area, structural conclusion, warning/error severity, review/approval, real-pair, parameter coverage or normative claim. No new hash helper or invented member ID. Later selectors must use full source hash+page+sourcePath+exact raw and complete original; selection does not create physical identity.

An empty literals array means only no supported language on eligible pages; it never means no columns/pylons, equal/no-difference, negative scope, complete audit or successful KR060 comparison. No runtime, HTTP/UI, migrations, registry/atomic rules, H100/browser/DOM in this packet.
